body.statement: On the simultaneous event \(p\in\mathcal C_n(\alpha)\), every data-dependent deployed mixture \(\widetilde q_x\in\Delta_K\) satisfies \(R_x(\widetilde q_x,p_x)\leq\overline R_{x,n}(\widetilde q_x;\alpha)\) for every \(x\). Consequently, with probability at least \(1-\alpha\), all deployed-stratum inequalities hold simultaneously, including the reported numerical primal--dual gap.
body.justification: Coverage of an optimizer set does not by itself certify the actual policy sent to deployment.
body.gap: ClopperPearson1934Binomial supplies cellwise coverage, but the decision-level robust regret certificate and solver-error accounting are absent from categorical-instrument policy learning.
body.consumer: A clinical or public-policy deployment can report an auditable upper bound on worst-case welfare loss for the mixture actually used.
